notes.title: Update Patch Notes - January 9, 2023
notes.content:
[h3]The following updates have been implemented:[/h3]

[b]Added[/b] HELP LINE for better aiming
[b]Added [/b]Option to turn off TRAPS for more casual gaming.

You can ON/OFF both of these things in the Settings menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622455/b18250b16071bf82a8c87213345b08e0ec176568.png[/img]

Have fun, folks! and Save All the Cute Animals from the Flood! :D

[b]@FobTi[/b]

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - September 2, 2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35622455/38c2bfc3acf67b76dbdab63be623692c2810fe31.gif[/img]

[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Changed function for the second button(key). From now, you can't stop the move, only change the direction.
[*] Changed spike trap. Added "shine fx" for better visibility.
[/list]

[i]Happy gaming! :) and Save All the Cute Animals from the Flood! :D[/i]
